title: Move Tool
description: Move and arrange a layer or selection.
try_it: Choose the intended layer, then drag it on the canvas.

title: Artboard Tool
description: Organize designs into separate canvas areas.
try_it: Use the artboard controls to create, select, or resize an artboard.

title: Rectangular Marquee Tool
description: Select a rectangular area.
try_it: Drag a box around the part of the image you want to affect.

title: Elliptical Marquee Tool
description: Select an oval or circular area.
try_it: Drag an oval around the area you want to affect.

title: Single Row Marquee Tool
description: Select one horizontal row of pixels.
try_it: Click the row you want to select.

title: Single Column Marquee Tool
description: Select one vertical column of pixels.
try_it: Click the column you want to select.

title: Lasso Tool
description: Draw a freehand selection.
try_it: Drag around an area and close the outline.

title: Polygonal Lasso Tool
description: Build a selection from straight edges.
try_it: Click successive corners, then close the outline.

title: Magnetic Lasso Tool
description: Trace a selection along visible edges.
try_it: Follow a contrasting edge and close the outline; check the result before editing.

title: Object Selection Tool
description: Find an object inside an area you indicate.
try_it: Enclose the object, inspect the selection, and refine any missed edges.

title: Quick Selection Tool
description: Grow a selection by brushing over an object.
try_it: Paint inside the object and refine the selection near its edges.

title: Magic Wand Tool
description: Select an area by similar colors.
try_it: Click a color and adjust tolerance to include more or less of the image.

title: Crop Tool
description: Trim the image to a new boundary.
try_it: Drag and adjust the crop frame, then confirm the crop.

title: Perspective Crop Tool
description: Crop while straightening a tilted surface.
try_it: Place the crop corners around the surface, then confirm.

title: Slice Tool
description: Divide a design into export regions.
try_it: Drag slice boundaries around the regions you want to organize.

title: Slice Select Tool
description: Select and adjust existing slices.
try_it: Click a slice to move or resize its boundary.

title: Frame Tool
description: Create an image container.
try_it: Drag a frame and use its content controls to place and adjust an image.

title: Eyedropper Tool
description: Sample a color from the image.
try_it: Click the color you want to use for painting.

title: Color Sampler Tool
description: Keep reference points for checking colors.
try_it: Place sample points and inspect their color readings.

title: Ruler Tool
description: Measure distance and angles.
try_it: Drag between two points and review the measurement controls.

title: Note Tool
description: Attach a comment to the document.
try_it: Click where the note belongs and enter its text.

title: Count Tool
description: Mark and count items in an image.
try_it: Click each item you want included in the count.

title: Spot Healing Brush Tool
description: Blend small blemishes into nearby surroundings.
try_it: Use a brush slightly larger than the blemish and make a short stroke.

title: Remove Tool
description: Retouch an unwanted object or distraction.
try_it: Brush over the unwanted area, then inspect the replacement for artifacts.

title: Healing Brush Tool
description: Blend texture from a sampled source into a target area.
try_it: Set a source using the sampling modifier shown by the tool, then brush the target.

title: Patch Tool
description: Repair a selected area with another image region.
try_it: Outline the problem area and use the patch controls to choose replacement content.

title: Content-Aware Move Tool
description: Move an object while repairing its old location.
try_it: Select the object, move it, and inspect both the old and new edges.

title: Red Eye Tool
description: Reduce red-eye in flash portraits.
try_it: Click the affected pupil and review the correction.

title: Brush Tool
description: Paint soft or textured strokes.
try_it: Choose a color, brush size, and opacity, then drag on a paintable layer.

title: Pencil Tool
description: Paint crisp, hard-edged pixels.
try_it: Choose a small size for precise pixel work, then draw.

title: Color Replacement Tool
description: Replace a sampled color while brushing.
try_it: Choose a replacement color and brush over the target area; review tolerance settings.

title: Mixer Brush Tool
description: Blend paint colors in brush strokes.
try_it: Review the mixing and wetness controls, then paint on a suitable layer.

title: Clone Stamp Tool
description: Copy image pixels from a sampled source.
try_it: Set a source using the sampling modifier shown by the tool, then paint the copy.

title: Pattern Stamp Tool
description: Paint with a repeating pattern.
try_it: Choose a pattern and brush size, then paint on a suitable layer.

title: History Brush Tool
description: Brush back content from a history source.
try_it: Choose the intended history source before painting the area to restore.

title: Art History Brush Tool
description: Repaint from a history source with stylized strokes.
try_it: Choose a history source and style, then try a short stroke.

title: Eraser Tool
description: Remove pixels from a paintable layer.
try_it: Brush over the area you want to erase; use a mask when you want a reversible hide.

title: Background Eraser Tool
description: Erase around a sampled background color.
try_it: Work along the edge and adjust sampling and tolerance for your image.

title: Magic Eraser Tool
description: Erase areas of similar color with a click.
try_it: Click the target color and check the tolerance before repeating.

title: Gradient Tool
description: Fill an area with a gradual color transition.
try_it: Choose the gradient colors and style, then drag to set its direction and distance.

title: Paint Bucket Tool
description: Fill a color region.
try_it: Choose a fill color and click the region; tolerance controls how far the fill spreads.

title: Blur Tool
description: Soften local detail and edges.
try_it: Brush lightly over the area you want to soften.

title: Sharpen Tool
description: Increase local edge contrast.
try_it: Use short, low-strength strokes and watch for halos.

title: Smudge Tool
description: Drag nearby colors into one another.
try_it: Drag across an edge to push and blend pixels.

title: Dodge Tool
description: Lighten selected areas with a brush.
try_it: Use low exposure and build the effect with short strokes.

title: Burn Tool
description: Darken selected areas with a brush.
try_it: Use low exposure and build the effect gradually.

title: Sponge Tool
description: Change color intensity locally.
try_it: Choose the saturation mode, then brush the area.

title: Pen Tool
description: Draw precise paths with anchor points.
try_it: Click for straight segments and drag a point to shape a curve.

title: Freeform Pen Tool
description: Sketch a path freehand.
try_it: Draw the outline and refine its anchor points afterward.

title: Curvature Pen Tool
description: Build a path with smooth curves.
try_it: Place points along the outline and adjust the curve through them.

title: Add Anchor Point Tool
description: Add an editable point to a path.
try_it: Click the path where you need more control.

title: Delete Anchor Point Tool
description: Remove a point from a path.
try_it: Click an existing anchor and check how the neighboring curve changes.

title: Convert Point Tool
description: Change the way a path bends at an anchor.
try_it: Adjust the point and its handles to switch between a corner and a curve.

title: Horizontal Type Tool
description: Add editable horizontal text.
try_it: Click for a line of text or drag for a text box, then type.

title: Vertical Type Tool
description: Add editable vertical text.
try_it: Click or drag a text area, then type and adjust the text controls.

title: Vertical Type Mask Tool
description: Turn vertical lettering into a selection.
try_it: Type vertically and use the letter-shaped selection to limit an edit.

title: Horizontal Type Mask Tool
description: Turn horizontal lettering into a selection.
try_it: Type the words, then use the resulting letter-shaped selection for an edit or mask.

title: Path Selection Tool
description: Select and move an entire path.
try_it: Click a path, then drag it as a whole.

title: Direct Selection Tool
description: Edit individual path points and handles.
try_it: Select an anchor or handle and drag it to reshape that part of the path.

title: Rectangle Tool
description: Draw rectangular shapes.
try_it: Drag a rectangle and review fill and stroke settings.

title: Ellipse Tool
description: Draw oval or circular shapes.
try_it: Drag an ellipse and review fill and stroke settings.

title: Triangle Tool
description: Draw a triangular shape.
try_it: Drag to place the triangle, then adjust its appearance.

title: Polygon Tool
description: Draw a multi-sided shape.
try_it: Choose the side count in the tool controls, then drag the shape.

title: Line Tool
description: Draw a straight line.
try_it: Drag between its endpoints and adjust stroke settings.

title: Custom Shape Tool
description: Place a shape from the shape presets.
try_it: Choose a preset, then drag to size and place it.

title: Hand Tool
description: Pan around the view.
try_it: Drag the canvas to move your view without moving image pixels.

title: Rotate View Tool
description: Rotate your view for a comfortable drawing angle.
try_it: Drag to rotate the view; this does not rotate the image pixels.

title: Zoom Tool
description: Look closer or see more of the image.
try_it: Click or use the zoom controls to change the view magnification.
